# RetailPulse — DAX Implementation Checklist (Power BI Desktop, Windows)

**Generated by** `scripts/build_dax_audit.py` from `dax_measures.md` and `dax_validation_results.csv`. Do not edit by hand. Copy the formatted DAX from [`dax_measures.md`](dax_measures.md); the one-line form below is also valid DAX.

**84 measures**, listed in **entry order**: every measure appears after the measures it references, so each one can be committed without errors as you go.

> **Logic validated, runtime not.** `scripts/validate_dax_logic.py` passes 230/230 checks comparing each measure's logic with independent SQL. That does **not** prove the DAX parses or evaluates identically in Power BI. Tick *Syntax OK* and *Value OK* only after checking in Power BI Desktop.

**How to test a value:** put the measure on a card with no slicers applied (or the stated context) and compare with *Test value*. All test values and contexts are in [`dax_validation_results.csv`](dax_validation_results.csv) (column `expected`).
